title: WorkbookFolder
description: A folder of the workbook tree (workbooktree/**/dashql-folder.json). The directories of the workbook tree are the folders of the sidebar, the directory name is the folder name. Every directory holds one folder file with the workbooks of the folder.

workbooks.description: The workbooks of the folder, in the order of the sidebar. The subfolders are listed before them, in the natural order of their names.

WorkbookEntry.description: A workbook of the workbook tree

path.description: The workbook identity as a bare workbook UUID.

storageType.description: Where this workbook's files live. Defaults to "opfs" when omitted (the OPFS root). "native" means the files live directly in `nativePath`. Mirrors the `storageType` field on the workbook itself.

nativePath.description: Absolute directory holding this workbook's files. Required when storageType is "native"; one directory holds exactly one workbook.
